dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), GnuCOBOL-based open source system used in Japanese medical clinics

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (レセプト請求書) - specifically Fukuoka city 41-type welfare medical expense claim form for social insurance and self-pay patients (141, 241 types)
purpose.summary: This program generates medical insurance claim forms (レセプト/seikyu-sho) for the Fukuoka city 41-type welfare medical billing category. It reads patient and insurance data, processes billing records, and outputs formatted claim documents. It is part of the JMA ORCA open-source standard receipt software system used by Japanese medical institutions.

notable_features: 28 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPSK1001.INC, CPSK1002.INC, CPPRTDATA.INC, etc.)
54 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem routines (ORCSJOB, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for batch invocation
UNSTRING used to parse comma-delimited command parameters
REDEFINES clauses for hospital name/address fields
OCCURS 100 table for insurance combination parameters
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoded, displayed as latin-1 mojibake)
Version history spanning 2005-2015 with named maintainers
SPA-AREA (shared parameter area) pattern typical of ORCA
INITIALIZE used extensively for area clearing
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing Japanese characters to appear as mojibake in the comments and string literals. Content is clearly identifiable as JMA ORCA system code. Truncated at 16000 chars out of ~81KB total; PROCEDURE DIVISION logic is only partially visible but structure is clear.
